Hi Ellen — great questions, thank you. High-level summary is below and I attached an evidence matrix and our eval sampling plan. Short answers so you can circulate with your auditors; happy to join a call if any item needs deeper detail.

1) Evidence matrix: attached (redwood_evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx). It maps artifacts to NIST AI RMF functions (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage) and includes links to internal playbooks and runtime telemetry that we can share under NDA. Artifacts included: model card, versioned checkpoints, training dataset manifests, provenance hash logs, quantization audit trail, security review notes, and SOC 2 control mappings.

2) Regression & eval cadence: we run continuous smoke tests on canary traffic, daily synthetic evaluations (regression suites) for core prompts, and weekly stratified sampling on production logs for behavioral drift. Attached: eval_sampling_plan.pdf. Canary deployment thresholds: 95th-percentile latency within SLA AND no more than 1.5% top-level metric regression (user-facing accuracy/QA) across the primary prompt set. If thresholds fail we automatically route to the previous stable model and open an incident. For high-risk customers we default to conservative canary sizes (1% traffic) and require manual sign-off for rollback.

3) EU AI Act positioning: for high-risk categories we provide the full conformity package: model documentation (model card + technical documentation), risk assessment (SRA) tied to mitigation controls, human oversight SOPs, and evidence of post-market monitoring (PMM) as part of our Optimize product. We consider classification under the EU AI Act during onboarding. For regulated workloads we recommend Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) + Dedicated tenancy so data residency and traceability satisfy the Article 13/14 requirements. See section 4 of the evidence matrix for required artifacts.

I've copied Ben and Marissa to coordinate contract/legal questions and Grace from Applied ML for technical detail. Let us know the best time for a 30-min slot; we have availability Wed/Thu morning PST.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx; eval_sampling_plan.pdf; SOC2-summary.pdf
